pharmacySolutions.title: Pharmacy Solutions
pharmacySolutions.description: A secure, user-friendly e-commerce platform for buying medicines and medical supplies online.
pharmacySolutions.challenge: Pharmacies in Kuwait needed a way to sell medicines and medical supplies online without sacrificing the trust and accuracy a pharmacy requires.
pharmacySolutions.approach: We built a secure e-commerce platform with verified product listings, prescription-aware checkout, and an admin panel built around how a pharmacy actually manages stock.
pharmacySolutions.result: A live platform pharmacy staff can run day-to-day, with a shopping experience customers trust.

fekrativity.title: Fekrativity
fekrativity.description: An events management agency site covering everything from concept design to execution, with VR/AR experiences.
fekrativity.challenge: An events management agency needed a site that could showcase end-to-end event production — from concept to execution — including immersive VR/AR experiences.
fekrativity.approach: We designed a portfolio-driven site structured around their service categories, built to present past events and immersive experiences clearly to prospective clients.
fekrativity.result: A professional online presence that reflects the creativity of their event production work.

wildOasis.title: Wild Oasis
wildOasis.description: A luxury cabin booking platform with immersive mountain-forest visuals and reservation management.
wildOasis.challenge: A cabin rental business needed a booking platform that matched the immersive, high-end feel of staying in a mountain-forest cabin.
wildOasis.approach: We built a reservation system with real-time availability and rich visuals, so the booking experience feels as premium as the stay itself.
wildOasis.result: A booking platform guests can browse and reserve confidently, end to end.

beautyCenter.title: Beauty Center
beautyCenter.description: A Saudi B2B marketplace uniting local and global beauty brands across 800,000+ products.
beautyCenter.challenge: A Saudi B2B marketplace needed to unite local and global beauty brands across hundreds of thousands of products in one usable platform.
beautyCenter.approach: We built a B2B e-commerce experience designed for bulk browsing and ordering at scale, organizing a massive catalog without overwhelming buyers.
beautyCenter.result: A marketplace that makes an 800,000+ product catalog genuinely navigable for business buyers.

ezyRent.title: EzyRent
ezyRent.description: A global rental marketplace with real-time availability across thousands of verified listings.
ezyRent.challenge: A rental marketplace needed real-time availability across thousands of listings without the search experience breaking down at scale.
ezyRent.approach: We built a fast, filterable browsing experience backed by a marketplace architecture that keeps availability accurate as listings grow.
ezyRent.result: A rental platform that stays fast and reliable as its listing count scales.

keyper.title: Keyper
keyper.description: A premium landing page for a real estate advisory firm, guiding clients from discovery to closing.
keyper.challenge: A real estate advisory firm needed a landing page that could guide prospective clients from first visit to a booked consultation.
keyper.approach: We designed a focused, premium landing page structured around the firm's advisory process, from discovery to closing.
keyper.result: A clear, professional entry point that turns visits into consultations.

discoverEgypt.title: Discover Egypt
discoverEgypt.description: A travel companion platform blending historical exploration with modern, verified local insights.
discoverEgypt.challenge: Travelers exploring Egypt needed a single, modern platform blending historical context with verified, practical local insights.
discoverEgypt.approach: We built a travel companion experience that pairs historical exploration content with up-to-date, locally verified information.
discoverEgypt.result: A modern guide that makes discovering Egypt easier and more reliable for visitors.

faq.q1: Is School 360 built on a platform we can trust long-term?
faq.a1: Yes — it's built on Odoo 19, a mature open-source ERP used worldwide, so you're never locked into a closed system.
faq.q2: Can it be customized for how our school actually works?
faq.a2: Yes — as an Odoo-based system, modules can be configured or extended to match your school's specific workflow.
faq.q3: Does it really work fully in Arabic?
faq.a3: Completely. The portal, notifications, and reports are fully localized for Arabic-speaking staff, parents and students.
